title: Personalized Remote Health Monitoring and Clinical Report Generation Using Multi-Agent LLM Framework on Wearable Data

contributions.purpose: 将可穿戴数据+元数据转为临床式日/周报告
contributions.mechanism: 5个专职agent(异常/趋势/建议/日综合/周聚合)经DeepSeek迭代通信
contributions.evaluation: 异常检测precision 0.89、recall 0.91(41/45注入异常);盲评1-3分:相关性2.7/个性化2.5/清晰2.8
contributions.domain: 可穿戴健康监测/多agent LLM
contributions.source_quote: We present a modular multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework that converts longitudinal wearable data plus personal metadata (age, BMI, smoking status, and comorbidities) into clinician-style daily and weekly narratives with targeted recommendations.

contributions.purpose: 提供无PHI的合成评测数据集
contributions.mechanism: 基于NHANES/临床指南参数化生成50用户×7天,35%注入异常
contributions.source_quote: To enable reproducible evaluation without PHI, we generate a medically grounded synthetic dataset of 50 users over 7 days, with anomalies injected in 35% of users.

contributions.purpose: 消融证明个性化与多agent价值
contributions.mechanism: 逐项去除模块并与单agent基线对比
contributions.evaluation: 去个性化个体化-24%(2.5→1.9);单agent基线个体化1.8 vs 多agent 2.5
contributions.source_quote: An ablation shows that removing personalization reduces individualization by ~24% (~25%), and replacing the multi-agent pipeline with a single-agent baseline lowers average scores across relevance, personalization, and clarity.

notes: 数据红旗:全部数据由NumPy合成(固定种子造数),异常由作者"注入"再由自家Anomaly Agent检测,构成循环自证(伪ground-truth自评);LLM-as-judge用ChatGPT-5评自家输出,人评仅3人(2医生+1公卫)15条日报。幻影引用:正文两处"[?]"(数据质量与相关约束处);ref[93]与[5]完全重复。checklist AI披露:实验[C](用Claude/Qwen/GPT/Kimi,Claude最多)、分析[B]、写作[D](GPT/Claude/Grok);AI局限自认Claude"给睡眠阶段分配步数"等医学不可能错误、需人工核验全部生成数据。trade-off:承认合成数据外部效度不足。
